retroarch.cfg.text:
# Generated by Piko. RetroArch reads this file from the application directory
# and rewrites it in place on exit. The directories below point into the package
# persistent tree so saves, states, BIOS files and downloaded cores survive
# version upgrades.
savefile_directory = "{{persist}}/saves"
savestate_directory = "{{persist}}/states"
screenshot_directory = "{{persist}}/screenshots"
system_directory = "{{persist}}/system"
libretro_directory = "{{persist}}/cores"
playlist_directory = "{{persist}}/playlists"
thumbnails_directory = "{{persist}}/thumbnails"
